task: Native Voxel One Game Engine Editor interface
environment: Linux X11, Mesa software rendering, Oracle JDK 21.0.5. Inherited assigned DISPLAY and XAUTHORITY; no new X server. Isolated synthetic city and user home under target/editor-profile and target/editor-home.
scope: Engine workspace for the active City Builder or Sandbox game, scene group inspector, existing voxel asset tool, Play/Return controls, local city-time pause, --editor startup option. Arbitrary game creation and code editing are not implemented.

earlierAttempts: Initial broad test run used default /tmp and hit read-only temporary-directory errors; it was cancelled and is not a full-suite pass. Native attempts exposed startup/timing and coordinate assumptions in the harness, plus a real cursor-tracking bug fixed in Main. Final focused tests and native run were repeated after the cursor fix and legacy-binding change.
limitations: Multiplayer workspace live-server text is implemented; no multiplayer session was exercised for this item.

reviewFix: Direct engine workspace binding is handled before model-editor input. Shared openEngineWorkspace closes the asset tool through closeEditor, commits a valid focused name draft, ends drag, retains the model, and releases the pointer. Keyboard and mouse bindings use the same path.

audit.result: Entire proposed diff inspected against supplied review base. Only editor source, controls, docs, harnesses, progress entry and editor evidence change. No file deletions or unrelated removed features. Existing city, vehicle, save and asset systems remain present.
audit.intendedReplacements: Existing input, simulation, camera and audio guard lines are replaced with workspace-aware guards. The controls enum terminator is changed to append ENGINE_EDITOR. Docs now state direct F11 return and draft retention.
